===Etymology 1===
{{img
|image1=board.agr.jpg|caption1={{lang|en|A wooden '''board'''}}
|image2=Board, duplicate bridge (1).png|caption2={{lang|en|'''Board''' (duplicate bridge)}}
}}
{{etymon|en|id=piece of wood|:inh|enm:bord}}
From {{inh|en|enm|boord}}, {{m|enm|boorde}}, {{m|enm|bord}}, {{m|enm|bourd}}, {{m|enm|burd}}, from {{inh|en|ang|bord}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*bord}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*burdą|t=board, plank; edge; table}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*bʰers-|t=tip, top}} + {{m|ine-pro|*-dʰeti}} or {{m|ine-pro|*bʰerH-|t=to pierce; to strike}} + {{m|ine-pro|*-dʰeti}}. The senses "food" and "council" are by [[Appendix:Glossary#metonym|metonymy]] from the sense "table".
{{col-top|2|cog}}
Cognate with {{cog|sco|buird|t=board; table}}, {{cog|yol|borde|t=table}}, {{cog|fy|boerd|t=board}}, {{cog|nl|bord|t=dish, plate; board, plank; sign}}, {{m|nl|boord|t=border, boundary; bank, shore}}, {{cog|de|Bord|t=shelf}}, {{cog|da,nb,nn,sv|bord|t=plank; table}}, {{cog|ovd|buord|t=table}}, {{cog|fo,is|borð|t=board, plank; table}}, {{cog|got|*𐌱𐌰𐌿𐍂𐌳|t=board, plank}} (whence {{m|got|𐍆𐍉𐍄𐌿𐌱𐌰𐌿𐍂𐌳|t=footstool}}.

====Noun====
{{en-noun|~}}

# {{senseid|en|long, somewhat wide, thin piece of material}} A relatively long, wide and thin piece of any material, usually [[wood]] or similar, often for use in [[construction]] or [[furniture]]-making.
#* {{RQ:Churchill Celebrity|chapter=2|passage=Sunning himself on the '''board''' steps, I saw for the first time Mr. Farquhar Fenelon Cooke. He was dressed out in broad gaiters and bright tweeds, like an English tourist, and his face might have belonged to Dagon, idol of the Philistines.}}
# {{senseid|en|switchboard or similar device}} A device ([[e.g.]], [[switchboard]]) containing [[electrical]] [[switch]]es and other [[control]]s and designed to control [[light]]s, [[sound]], [[telephone]] [[connection]]s, etc.
# {{senseid|en|board game surface}} A flat surface with markings for playing a [[board game]].
#: {{ux|en|Each player starts the game with four counters on the '''board'''.}}
# {{senseid|en|clipping of blackboard, surfboard, or others}} {{n-g|Short for [[blackboard]], [[whiteboard]], [[chessboard]], [[surfboard]], [[circuit board]], [[message board]] (on the Internet), [[bulletin board]], etc.}}
# {{senseid|en|committee of managers}} A [[committee]] that [[manage]]s the [[business]] of an [[organization]].<!--e.g., board of directors, board of supervisors, board of advisers, advisory board-->
#: {{ux|en|We have to wait to hear back from the '''board'''.}}
## {{senseid|en|Q188628}} {{lb|en|often|specifically}} {{ellipsis of|en|board of directors<id:Q188628>}}.
##: {{ux|en|The CEO can expect a revolt from the '''board''' if she tries to restructure the acquisition at this late stage.}}
# {{senseid|en|meals at table, or their price}} {{lb|en|uncountable}} Regular [[meal]]s in a place of [[lodging]]; the [[price]] paid for them.
#: {{co|en|[[board and lodging|'''board''' and lodging]]}}
#: {{co|en|[[room and board|room and '''board''']]}}
#: {{ux|en|His '''board''' was served by his landlady, the owner of the boarding house. [meals]}}
#: {{ux|en|His '''board''' seemed a bit steep, but he accepted it because the house was clean and his fellow lodgers were respectful neighbors. [price for meals]}}
# {{senseid|en|side of ship}} {{lb|en|nautical}} The [[side]] of a [[ship]].
#* {{RQ:Dryden Aeneis|5|passage=Now '''board''' to board the rival vessels row.}}
# {{senseid|en|distance between tacks in sailing windward}} {{lb|en|nautical}} The [[distance]] a [[sailing]] [[vessel]] runs between [[tack]]s when working to [[windward]].
# {{senseid|en|rink wall}} {{lb|en|ice hockey|often|in the plural}} The [[wall]] that surrounds an [[ice hockey]] [[rink]].
# {{senseid|en|dining table}} {{lb|en|archaic}} A long, narrow table, like that used in a [[medieval]] dining hall.
#* {{RQ:Milton Paradise Lost|book=5|passage=Fruit of all kinds {{...}} / She gathers, tribute large, and on the '''board''' / Heaps with unsparing hand.|year=1873}}
#* '''1890''', {{w|Algernon Blackwood}}, ''Christmas in England'', Methodist Magazine Volume 32 pg 481.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1913|author={{w|Norman Lindsay}}|title={{w|A Curate in Bohemia (novel)|A Curate in Bohemia}}|publisher=N.S.W. Bookstall Co.|year_published=1932|location=Sydney|page=17|passage="A man," added Cripps, pointing at the MacQuibble, who took no manner of notice, but smoked impassively, "who comes to my hospitable '''board''' meanly disguised as an artist, and filches the table wine."}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2007|author={{w|J. R. R. Tolkien}} edited by {{w|Christopher Tolkien}}|title=The Children of Húrin
|passage=Túrin took a seat without heed, for he was wayworn, and filled with thought; and by ill-luck he set himself at a '''board''' among the elders of the realm, and in that place where Saeros was accustomed to sit.}}
# {{senseid|en|thick, stiff paper}} Paper made thick and stiff like a board, for book covers, etc.; [[pasteboard]].
#: {{co|en|to bind a book in '''boards'''}}
# {{senseid|en|video game 2D level}} {{lb|en|video games}} A [[level]] or [[stage]] having a particular two-dimensional [[layout]].
#* {{quote-journal|en|year=2004|author=Dan Whitehead; Martyn Carroll; Shaun Bebbington|title=Future Shocks|journal=Your Sinclair|issue=94
|passage=The object of the game is to move the smiley face over the preset '''board''', in doing so removing the green squares and ending up at the exit {{...}}}}
# {{lb|en|[[TCG]]s}} The portion of the [[playing field]] where [[creature]]s or [[minions]] can be placed (or [[play]]ed, [[summoned]], etc.).
# {{senseid|en|card holder in bridge game}} {{label|en|bridge}} A container for holding pre-dealt cards that is used to allow multiple sets of players to play the same cards.
# {{lb|en|local government}} A [[Philippine]] [[provincial]] or [[Uruguayan]] [[departmental]] [[assembly]] or [[council]].
